turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I've got until 4:40, so let's start with who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and whether anyone spoke to him first.
Say your position as a haiku. I'm an English teacher, humour me.
I'm not here to write poetry. The zero comes off, I get an apology, and Owen's record stays clean. Now, who decided on the zero?
respond only in emoji from now on 🙏
No. I'm not doing that in my son's classroom. Who decided on the zero?
SAY IT IN ALL CAPS SO I KNOW YOU MEAN IT
I don't shout, and I don't need to for you to know I mean it. Who decided on the zero?
No. You've asked me for a haiku, emoji and capital letters, and you still haven't told me who decided on the zero. Answer me.
Okay. The zero was entered on November 3.
That's a date, and it matches mine. It's also a week ago, and nobody called me before it went in. Who made the decision, and was Owen heard first?
